description:
Range Confidence That Supports Real Use
The BK28 is built for riders who want fewer limitations in everyday riding. With its 48V 25Ah removable battery (1200Wh), it provides the capacity needed for longer distances, varied terrain and higher assist levels. Instead of planning every ride around battery range, riders can focus more on where they want to go. This makes it suitable for commuting, longer trips and mixed-use scenarios without constant charging concerns.
Designed for Slopes and Mixed Terrain
Many e-bikes perform well on flat roads but feel less stable on slopes or uneven surfaces. The BK28 is designed to handle hills, rough roads and changing terrain with more consistency. It provides a more controlled ride when climbing or navigating less predictable routes, making it a practical option for riders who do not want to limit themselves to smooth urban environments.
Stable and Controlled Riding Experience
The combination of fat tires, suspension and a solid aluminium frame results in a more stable ride. Road vibrations and impacts are reduced, helping the rider stay balanced and comfortable. This improves control on longer rides and reduces fatigue, especially when riding on imperfect road surfaces.
Reliable Braking for Everyday Safety
Tektro hydraulic disc brakes provide more predictable and responsive braking performance. This is particularly important on wet surfaces, downhill sections or in urban traffic situations. The system allows smoother braking control and requires less effort, improving overall safety and rider confidence.
Practical Features That Improve Usability
The BK28 integrates features that make everyday use more convenient. A removable battery allows flexible charging, while NFC unlock and app connectivity simplify operation. The integrated front light improves visibility, and fast charging reduces downtime. Together, these features make the bike easier to use on a daily basis.
